name: directory-name-intermediate-subject-outside-permit-invalid
description: directoryName constraints apply to non-self-issued intermediate CA subjects as well as leaf subjects. The upper CA permits only C=US,O=Permitted Org; the lower CA's subject is C=US,O=Other Org,CN=Bad CA, so path validation must reject before reaching the otherwise acceptable leaf.
notes: intermediate-san-outside-permitted-invalid covers a constrained SAN on an intermediate. This case covers the intermediate subject DN path specifically, where validators sometimes only enforce directoryName constraints at the final target.
